clips.title: The story
paras: At Windshear Crag, the Venture Co. Engineering Plans reveal how the logging machinery is built. Alliance operatives recover the schematics from the goblin mill.

Inside the lumber mill south of Cragpool Lake, the Venture Co. Engineering Plans show the construction, strengths, and flaws of the timber-harvesting machines. The Venture Company uses those machines to strip the forests of Stonetalon, while smoke hangs over Windshear Crag.
